subject: Brightline — initial tenant activation & admin/keying playbook
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@brightline.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Brightline — initial tenant activation & admin/keying playbook

Hi team,

Quick handoff — Brightline signed last week and wants to be live in our staging environment by next Tuesday (2026-09-01). Sara (cc'd) is Brightline's technical lead. Please see attached checklist and the scope doc; I've highlighted the nonstandard items Brightline asked for (ephemeral API keys for CI, two admin seats seeded, and an initial role for analytics-only users).

Immediate asks for implementation:
- Seed two admin API keys scoped to their workspace (one for CI/CD, one for ops).
- Create a service account for embedding jobs with limited token scope and a 30d TTL; we'll hand over rotation instructions.
- Create three user roles: Admin, Developer, Analytics-Viewer, and map initial team members (Sara will provide the roster).
- Invite cadence: stagger invites so we don't exceed their SSO onboarding window — propose Admin invites first, then Developers, then Analytics.

Sara — can you confirm the SSO provider (Okta/SAML/OIDC) and whether you want us to create placeholder accounts or wait for your IdP push? Also share the first two user emails for Admin seeding.

Jonas/Rishi — can you own seeding and give an ETA? I'll coordinate with Customer Success and include the HubSpot tasks.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: brightline_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 rows) ; initial-project-scope.md (markdown, 2 pages)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@brightline.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightline — initial tenant activation & admin/keying playbook

Thanks Monica — digging in.

Sara, great to meet you by email. Quick questions so we can make the activation deterministic:

1) SSO: Monica, please confirm Sara's answer. If Brightline uses Okta with IdP-initiated provisioning, we'll wait for the push; if it's SCIM or you want us to create placeholders, we'll create accounts and mark them as "invite pending."

2) API key policy and TTLs: Proposal below (we can change on your call):
   - Admin key (ops): long-lived (90d) for initial setup, limited to management routes. Rotate after first 30 days.
   - Admin key (CI): short-lived (14d) with a plan to rotate to ephemeral CI tokens tied to their pipeline.
   - Service account (embeddings): 30d TTL, limited to /embeddings and read-only metadata.

3) Namespaces & projects: We'll create a Brightline org namespace and two projects (staging, production). Keys will be created at the project level and labeled: brightline-staging-admin, brightline-staging-ci, brightline-embeddings.

4) Roles mapping (initial):
   - Admin -> full workspace admin
   - Developer -> generate/consume keys for project-level work, no billing controls
   - Analytics-Viewer -> embeddings inference only, no log access

Proposed timeline (based on the Sept 1 target):
   - Today: Confirm SSO and first two admin emails
   - Today EOD: Seed org namespace + create staging project and three placeholder keys (status: seeded, do not enable)
   - Wed: Send Admin invites (Jonas to send)
   - Thu-Fri: Developer invites and Service account handoff (Rishi owns service account creation + docs)
   - Next Mon (30 Aug): final verification with Sara in a 30m validation call

I'll take the seeding steps and mark secrets as disabled until we confirm cutover. Monica — please add the 30m validation call to Sara's calendar; we can do 10:00 PT on Mon if that works.

Jonas Weber
Technical Customer Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference

I can take the service account and the embeddings key handoff. Plan:

- Create service account: brightline-emb-service@redwood-svc (scopes: embeddings:generate, embeddings:read_metadata).
- TTL: 30d by default; will add rotation instructions to the drive doc and include a sample script for token rotation (bash + curl).
- For Admin keys: I'll create two placeholders as Jonas described and mark them disabled. Once Sara confirms which pipeline needs which key, we enable and hand over via DocuSign/HubSpot secure note.

Attachments I'll add to the Drive folder today: a short README (token-rotation.md) and the sample script.

ETA: service account + seeded keys created and disabled by 17:00 PT today.

Rishi
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

Action items I captured and owners:
- Jonas: create org namespace + staging project; seed placeholders and disabled keys (due today EOD).

- Monica: schedule 30m validation call Mon 2026-08-30 10:00 PT and update HubSpot with task BRG-421-KICKOFF.

I'll update the checklist and unassign items after validation. If anything blocks, flag here and I'll escalate.

Monica Patel
